title: Magic-Loot.lua [ATG HUB]
features:
Main
- Display player information
- Auto Click + adjustable speed
- Auto Rebirth at target level
- Auto Alchemy: select multiple recipes, auto-craft
- Auto Skip for the potion-brewing screen

Inventory
- Auto Pickup: select items, filter by rarity color/price, adjustable delay, auto-collect drops
- Auto Return: teleport back when inventory is full
- Auto Potion: select potions, modes (Use All / Highest Rarity / Rotate), adjustable delay
- Auto Sell: select materials, auto-sell, adjustable interval, "Sell All" button

Equipment
- Auto Buy Wands with dropdown list (item/price/rarity)
- Auto Buy Armor with dropdown list (item/price/rarity)
- Auto Buy Brooms with dropdown list (item/price/rarity)
- Auto Equip separately for wands, armor, and brooms after purchase

Events
- Auto Altar Exchange: choose Light/Dark, adjustable delay
- Auto Online Rewards: auto-claim rewards, adjustable check interval
- Auto Event Shop: select items and auto-redeem

Teleport
- Warp to Stack 4, 8, 13, 18, 23
- Auto Teleport: select stack, adjustable delay (1–240 seconds)
- Teleport to Player: select player, choose Instant/Tween/MoveTo, instant warp
- Auto-Follow selected player

Humanoid
- Walk Speed and Jump Power with force-value toggle
- Reset button for walk/jump values
- Fly, Fly Speed, Fly Hotkey
- Noclip

 Server
- Server Hop
- Rejoin
- Find low-population server
- Warp via Job ID
- Copy current Job ID

Settings
- Anti-AFK
- Auto Rejoin on disconnect/error prompt
- Fluent-based save/load settings system

 ESP
- Tab exists, but no ESP functions have been implemented in this file yet.
